Sent: Sunday, March 01, 2020 10:48 PM
To: AMBER Mailing List <amber.ambermd.org>
Subject: [AMBER] g09 genecp in QM/MM MD in amber
Dear All,
I saw an old question <
http://archive.ambermd.org/201307/0764.html
> related to using pseudopotentials during QM/MM-MD in Amber.
Thus I'm curious to know if this is possible in Amber19 now. I can't find an obvious answer from the manual section 10.2 and 10.2.6.3. The sub-section on the basis option doesn't mention ecp/pseudopotentials.
Will it work if I give the full information (coefficients) as given by GFPrint/GFInput keywords in g09? considering the complexity of the system setup, I wanted to understand the capabilities before spending 5-10 days on preparing the inputs.
Looking forward to getting valuable suggestions and hints from the list.
Thank you and best regards
Vaibhav

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Mon, Mar 02, 2020, James Kress wrote:
>Does anyone know the units for the ACOEF and BCOEF LJ parameters in prmtop?
Amber uses energy units of kcal/mol and distance units of Ang.
So ACOEFF is (kcal/mol)(�^12) and BCOEF is (kcal/mol)(�^6).
[Someone will no doubt correct me if this is is wrong....]
...dac
